sources.title: blaj/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-Uncensored-int4-ov · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An int4 OpenVINO IR conversion of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B with a rank-1 abliteration adapter fused into the weights. The edit is r24-all-14-39-perlayer, a rank-1 atomic.abliterate LoRA applied to decoder layers 14–39 (alpha 1.0, user scale 1.75, 1690 weights including all 64 experts per MoE block, plus attn_output and shortconv.out_proj).

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is the fastest of the compared MoEs at reading in prompts and generating answers. It decodes 184 tokens/s on an Apple M5 Max and 114 tokens/s on an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, up to 1.7x faster than the next-best model, while using the least memory.
